scope: Certificate-scoped reading of listed manufacturer cells of the Celestica manufacturer-query capture only. Each entry applies to exactly one certificate whose detail page and manufacturer cell hashes match; it is not a company alias, not a general split rule and not evidence about any other certificate or cell. Only names with a reviewed legal-name basis are mapped (role registry_manufacturer); other parts are kept as unmapped literal context with no role and no affiliation, as in rra-reviewed-manufacturer-lists. No factory, per-factory country or sole-manufacturer claim; the legal manufacturer is not necessarily the physical factory.
